title: Video & Temporal Understanding
description: Study frame sampling and event coverage, temporal ordering and synchronization, segment retrieval and evidence windows, and video evaluation and resource budgets. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Frame sampling and event coverage
lessons.description: Design a sampling plan for short safety warnings and estimate its processing cost.
lessons.conceptOverview: Sparse sampling lowers compute but can miss brief events. Choose sampling based on event duration, supplement it with change detection, and evaluate missed-event rates rather than only sampled-frame accuracy.
lessons.whyItMatters: Sampling policy determines which events can be observed.

lessons.title: Temporal ordering and synchronization
lessons.description: Propose an alignment check using a visible clap and an audible spike.
lessons.conceptOverview: Video reasoning requires ordered timestamps and alignment between audio, frames and subtitles. Constant clock offsets and drift can associate speech with the wrong event; retain the original timebase when transforming media.
lessons.whyItMatters: Cross-modal timestamps must be validated before reasoning about events.

lessons.title: Segment retrieval and evidence windows
lessons.description: Choose a context expansion policy and a citation interval that distinguishes evidence from surrounding context.
lessons.conceptOverview: Retrieve video segments with enough context to explain an event while keeping timestamps precise. Segment boundaries can split causes from outcomes, so retrieval may expand to adjacent context before answering.
lessons.whyItMatters: Evidence windows should preserve event context and precise timestamps.

lessons.title: Video evaluation and resource budgets
lessons.description: Write one static question and one ordering question about the same clip.
lessons.conceptOverview: Video workloads vary with duration, frame rate, resolution and audio processing. Evaluate temporal questions separately from single-frame questions and track total preprocessing, retrieval and generation latency.
lessons.whyItMatters: Temporal understanding needs temporal evaluation tasks.
